$comment: Wire contract for POST /api/geek-crawler/internal/rag/index-status. The RAG is the sender and this file is generated from its IndexStatusResponse model; GeekBackend keeps a byte-identical copy at GeekBackend/contracts/rag-index-status/webhook.v1.json and a test asserting its DTO binds every field here. Neither repo can see the other's types at compile time, so this file is the only thing standing between them. It exists because on 2026-09-29 five fields were found to be sent on every webhook and bound by nothing: pagesSkippedUnusable, attempt, trigger, embeddingRateLimitRetries, embeddingWaitSeconds. Dropping pagesSkippedUnusable meant a run whose corpus was gutted by 4xx error pages was indistinguishable from one that indexed cleanly, because the two benign skip reasons were bound and the one that indicts the crawl was not.

$notes.eventType: Not on the model. webhook.notify() adds it to the payload after model_dump, so it is on the wire and must be in this list.
$notes.persisted: GeekAPI persists five of these to crawl_runs as Rag* fields: state, chunksUpserted, pagesEnglish, pagesSkippedUnusable, finishedAtUtc. The rest reach SignalR only, which is live-only -- no listener at the time means the value is gone.
$notes.attempt: Bound and pushed but deliberately NOT used by the receiver's out-of-order guard, which keys on finishedAtUtc. Changing that is a behaviour decision, not a binding one.
